# Lex-Mex

> Selected Mexican legal corpus. Partial coverage; repository classifications are qualified.

Pin release `c305db4a3cfb408b76c13431e26beda72d5ce665046c95783fab36507354c969`. Background text retrieval must not change the human reader selection. Read only relevant shards; do not bulk-load the corpus.

## Corpus

- [Selected corpus](/lex-mex/releases/c305db4a3cfb408b76c13431e26beda72d5ce665046c95783fab36507354c969/index.md): per-instrument Markdown indexes and exact text links.
- [Manifest](/lex-mex/releases/c305db4a3cfb408b76c13431e26beda72d5ce665046c95783fab36507354c969/manifest.json): source snapshots, coverage, input and file hashes.

No last-successful-upstream-check ledger or historical validity guarantee is available.
